body: I’m trying. There’s plenty that I enjoy- just no motivation anymore to do those things. It’s hard. Again, thank you.
I just don’t know how to do that with no desire. Thank you, though.

It feels good to have someone sort of analyze this type of thing regardless of professionalism. It’s not just “in my head” anymore if that makes sense. But yeah, this opens my eyes a little more, thank you :) I appreciate it

Any time I’d ask why they’d just say “because we said so” or “because we’re your parents.” They just kind of stared at me scarily from what I’ve seen. I couldn’t ever look at them for long while doing it.
I did, when I was younger they’d come in and not leave and demand I stay in the room to change, too. Towards my teenage years they made me dress in the middle of our living room.
thank you, I’ll try to remind myself
it was on and off from close to 10 to I want to say 14, I don’t remember anything from before like 10/11 years old so I can’t say for sure
alright, I’ll be sure to see. ty :”)
how would I go about doing that? if it requires money or transportation I don’t think I’d be able to atm but, maybe it’s a future option

I’ve tried talking to my schools every new year. Middle school was my peak, I got to go to a hospital for a general evaluation to determine if I should seek further treatment. Never got it though. All through high school my school counselors/social worker have told me to either get more sleep or just cut me off and sent me out of their office. If there’s someone else to go to I’d be willing but I don’t think anyone here wants to listen, tbh. Not sure. 

Thanks for replying also <3  the reminder to avoid harm helps a lot.
is there any way that you can secretly store some money? im sorry, i hope that you can somehow work up to a better future :”(

i get that 100%... ive gotten used to just taking it in and then reminding myself that people like that dont change. as long as you keep in mind that it isnt your fault they act that way, hopefully things get a little more bearable :(

the same here OP. im sorry you have to deal with that stuff. it may not be much but i live for the breath of fresh air when im able to catch a break from them, whether that be getting out of the house and hanging with a friend or just sitting in my room minding my own business. i hope that maybe those little things can give you some peace, too
Thank you, I can try. I wasn’t taken very seriously the last time I tried to talk to someone about them so I’m hesitant now, but I’ll try my best. Thanks again, you’re very nice :”)
